title: Vendedor
description:
Se você tem foco em resultados, paixão por negociação estratégica e o desejo de atuar em uma empresa líder que não para de crescer, esta é a sua chance!


A Bem Brasil Alimentos, referência em qualidade e inovação no setor de alimentos, está buscando um(a) Vendedor Varejo para ser o nosso motor de crescimento na região metropolitana do Rio de Janeiro.


Sua missão será estratégica: atuar diretamente na rede de supermercados do Rio de Janeiro, garantindo a evolução das vendas e a presença imbatível da nossa linha de produtos, com foco especial na nossa estrela: a Batata Pré-Frita Congelada.


Local de Trabalho: Rio de Janeiro - RJ (Atuação na Região Metropolitana).


Suas Principais Responsabilidades Incluem:


- Gestão de Contas-Chave: Atendimento e desenvolvimento de grandes redes varejistas.


- Negociação Estratégica: Fechar acordos de sell-in e sell-out, negociar tablóides e garantir a melhor exposição dos produtos.


- Desenvolvimento de Mercado: Identificar novas oportunidades, prospectar clientes e treinar equipes comerciais dos distribuidores.


- Foco em KPI's: Acompanhar de perto o desempenho de vendas e desenvolver indicadores para maximizar a performance na sua regional.


Requisitos:


- Experiência sólida (mínimo de 2 anos) em vendas no setor de alimentos ou varejo.


- Formação Superior (completa ou em andamento) Administração, Marketing, em áreas correlatas.


- Habilidades essenciais: Foco em Resultados, Disciplina, Relacionamento Interpessoal e Competência Técnica em Negociação.


- Conhecimento em informática, com ênfase em Excel e Power Point.


Benefícios:

Convênio médico e odontológico;

Vale-alimentação e cesta básica;

Produtos da empresa;

Transporte fretado;

Participação nos Lucros e Resultados (PLR);

Auxílio-educação (conforme política interna);

Seguro de vida;

Auxílio-creche (para público elegível);

Acesso a plataforma Conexa Saúde;

Acesso a plataforma de viagens OnHappy;

Wellhub (antigo Gympass).


Se você está pronto para um desafio que exige garra, estratégia e paixão por vendas, e quer crescer em uma empresa que alimenta o Brasil, candidate-se agora!

title: Analista Administrativo
description:
Principais responsabilidades:


- Realizar todo processo de controle, conferência e execução de recebimentos quando pertinente, mediante organização e arquivo de documentos, preparação de malotes, efetuando entrega das chaves dos caminhões mediante protocolo, a fim de, garantir o controle para solicitação das devoluções das chaves ao final do dia, e baixas sistêmicas, evitando divergências, visando excelência na execução das atividades;

- Organizar e arquivar os canhotos de notas fiscais, mediante conferência e analise a partir da entrega dos motoristas, visando manter a documentação correta e organizada;

- Conferir o retorno dos mapas de carga, mediante entrega dos valores e documentações pertinentes recebidas pelos motoristas, a fim de, evitar divergências nos recebimentos, visando realizar o fechamento deles;

- Manter os relógios de ponto em pleno funcionamento, providenciando manutenção quando necessário;

- Atualizar os murais e comunicações internas, para divulgação de informações de interesse da empresa, em conformidade com as normas e procedimentos estabelecidos;

- Manter controledo estoque e distribuição aos colaboradores de uniformes e equipamentos de proteção individual (EPIs), controles de exames periódicos, gestão da CIPA e afins, visando dar suporte necessários aos assuntos relacionados ao SSMA (saúde, segurança e meio ambiente) e cumprir legislação vigente.


Requisitos Da Vaga:

  • Ensino Superior Completo;
  • Experiências emrotinas financeiras;
    contas a pagar e receber;
    atuar com report de serviços centralizados;
  • Disponibilidadepara o horário: Segunda a sexta ( 11:00 as 19:00 ) - Sábado ( 14:00 às 18:00 );
  • Habilidade em sistemas integrados e sistema SAP será um diferencial.


Beneficios:

  • Assistência médica e odontológica estendida a dependentes;
  • Seguro de vida;
  • Vale-alimentação;
  • Vale-refeição;
  • Wellhub;
  • Telemedicina gratuito estendido à dependentes.

title: Project Manager (Req. English)
description:
Fetchly Labs is a forward-thinking technology company specializing in innovative software solutions and digital products. We operate in a dynamic remote work environment that fosters collaboration and technological advancement across diverse project teams.
Job Responsibilities:
- Lead and manage software development projects from initiation to delivery, ensuring alignment with business goals and technical requirements
- Collaborate closely with product teams to define project scopes, timelines, and deliverables
- Utilize Agile methodologies to plan sprints, coordinate teams, and facilitate meetings
- Prepare comprehensive technical documentation and communicate effectively with stakeholders at all levels
- Identify, assess, and mitigate project risks to ensure timely and quality delivery
- Lead cross-functional teams, fostering a productive and motivated work environment
- Monitor project progress and performance metrics, providing regular updates to stakeholders
Required Qualifications:
- 2 to 5+ years of experience in project management and product management roles, preferably in technology or software development
- Proven knowledge of Agile methodologies and project management tools
- Strong technical background with the ability to understand complex product requirements
- Excellent English communication skills, ranging from intermediate to fluent
- College degree in a relevant field;
a Master’s degree or higher is preferred
Preferred Qualifications:
- Certification in Project Management (PMP, Scrum Master, or similar)
- Experience working in fully remote teams and across multiple time zones
- Advanced skills in stakeholder engagement and risk management
- Prior exposure to technical writing and documentation best practicesScreening questions

title: It Security & Compliance Consultant
description:
About you

You are someone who provide security, compliance, and risk oversight and drive the creation of the detailed inventory and classification of installed applications—ensuring the taxonomy defined in the charter is implemented (name, version, publisher, category, description, EOL date, plus owner/team fields for future phases), data is normalized across Systems, and risks are surfaced with clear next steps.


You bring to Applaudo the following competencies:

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related field (preferred) or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
  • 5–7+ years of experience in security, compliance, or Software Asset Management (SAM) governance.
  • Hands-on experience with Intune, NinjaOne, and ServiceNow SAM.
  • Strong skills in data normalization, taxonomy design, and software lifecycle/EOL management.
  • Excellent analytical and problem-solving abilities with a keen eye for data quality and governance.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills to coordinate across technical and business teams.
  • Ability to document processes, identify risks, and provide structured recommendations.
  • Advanced English proficiency to interact effectively with global stakeholders.


You will be accountable for the following responsibilities:

  • Detailed Inventory Build (Installed Apps): Lead aggregation from multiple sources;
    reconcile source differences;
    produce a single authoritative baseline of applications and versions for workstations, mobile devices, and servers.
  • Classification & Taxonomy Execution: Implement the charter’s taxonomy fields (Application name, Version, Publisher, Category, Description, End-of-life date;
    define placeholders forPrimary Business Owner, Technical Owner, Team using the application for future phases). Ensure every discovered app is categorized per the defined category scheme and platform (Win/Mac/iOS/Android/Server).
  • Normalization Rules: Define and apply deduplication and normalization (e.G., normalize publisher strings, collapse installer variants, consolidate minor version drift) so each entry represents a canonical application + version.
  • Quality & Coverage Checks: Establish data-quality gates (required fields populated for scope;
    minimal “Unknown publisher” entries;
    alignment of device coverage to endpoints in scope). Maintain an Excluded Items log for anything out-of-scope with rationale.
  • Security/EOL Enrichment: Add security-relevant attributes/workflows (EOL flagging, vulnerable/high-risk categories, privileged tools). Create a practical CVE lookup workflow for later phases;
    prioritize EOL and obviously risky categories.
  • Validation with Business: Facilitate validation sessions with Managing Directors/Dept Leads to confirm the catalog reflects reality;
    capture deltas and residual risks.
  • Risk Assessment & Inputs to Roadmap: Document findings (unsupported software, shadow IT indicators, risky categories) and quick wins that feed the implementation roadmap/policies (policy drafting is later-phase).


Additional Information

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

title: Senior Software Test Designer
description:
At TOPIC (in the Netherlands) we work every day on high-tech innovations to make the world smarter, healthier, and better. Are you a driven and ambitious Senior Software Test Designer with a track record to oversee the entire testing strategies, process, from planning to execution that we are looking for?


“TOPIC is unique because it combines cutting-edge technology with a strong culture of collaboration and knowledge sharing. It offers the opportunity to work on impactful, real-world projects in an environment that supports both personal and professional growth."


Bohdan Dovbysh I Test Automation Engineer


What will you do as a Senior Software Test Designer?

As a Senior Software Test Designer, you’ll lead the development of automated tests and qualification tools. You’ll design and implement smart testing strategies, optimize processes, and collaborate with internal and external stakeholders to ensure seamless integration and continuous improvement. By mentoring junior engineers and acting as a sparring partner for customers, you’ll help raise the bar for quality and innovation.


Your responsibilities as a Senior Software Test Designer:

  • Overseeing the entire testing architecture/ strategies, process, from planning to execution. This role involves developing automated test capabilities, selecting tools, and defining processes for efficient and effective testing;
  • Write software (C++, C, Python) for objective, reproducible and maintainable automated tests and development of tools for qualification and integration;
  • Explore different solution approaches to achieve the best result;
  • Design, implement and optimize chosen solutions;
  • Collaborate with internal and external stakeholders in an international, multidisciplinary, and Agile environment;
  • Review code andmentor (junior) engineers;
  • Share your expertise to elevate the team, quality, and processes;
  • Advisor and sparring partner for customers and stakeholders and inspiring others to strive for quality.


What do we offer you?

This will make you smarter:

  • challenging and interesting projects in different domains;
  • benefit from the expertise of your technical buddy and more than 100 smart colleagues;
  • focus on guiding and coaching on personal development to achieve your ambitions;
  • annual study budget and customized training program within our TOPIC Academy;
  • tech events andknowledge sessions.


This will make you better:

  • contract for indefinite period of time;
  • an all-in employee benefit package ( €61.000 – €85.000 annually): incl. competitive gross salary, net cost allowance, mobility package, 13th month payment, holiday allowance;
  • good secondary employment conditions: i.A. 26 vacation days (opportunity to buy extra days), pension scheme and relocation budget.


This will keep you healthy:

  • a good work-life balance, flexible working hours and hybrid way of working;
  • an inspiring office environment with daily fresh fruit and a gym;
  • the home officesupport package will turn your “home office” into an inspiring environment;
  • lots of fun during events like celebrations, sport activities and the weekly Friday afternoon drinks.


What do you bring as a Senior Software Test Designer?

  • A Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Embedded Systems or similar;
  • At least 7 years of experience in software development with Python and C/C++ in the high-tech domain;
  • You are capableof defining and overseeing the complete test architecture and strategy, ensuring consistency and quality from planning to execution;
  • A background insoftware development/ automation and experience with Object-Oriented programming and develop test frameworks for complex embedded systems;
  • Preferably experience with end-to-end test automation, continuous integration and setting up and maintaining ROBOT test framework;
  • You have provenexperience with various testing techniques, solid knowledge of higher-level testing (system integration, component testing), and are familiar with methods such as BDD, keyword-driven testing, data-driven testing, model-based testing, and property-based testing;
  • You are a team player, solution-oriented, and proactive;
  • Motivation to continuously improve yourself and develop new skills;
  • A good command of English, and preferably Dutch language.


Our organization

Since 1996 we have been developing (embedded) systems that are essential for products manufactured by renowned high-tech companies around the world. Our projects involve edge to cloud solutions;
from PCB design and FPGA to low level embedded software and application software for UI, Web, Mobile and cloud. We are well known for our high level of knowledge and expertise and are proud to be a Premier Adaptive Computing Partner of AMD;
technology leader in the field of System-on-Chips and FPGAs.


Diversity & Inclusion

At TOPIC, we believe that true innovation happens when people with different backgrounds, ideas, and perspectives come together. Every talent counts, and every voice matters. Diversity strengthens our creativity, and inclusion ensures that everyone feels welcome and valued. We build a culture where everyone has the space to contribute and be themselves.

description:
Paid Media Campaign Manager (Remote)

Location: Remote

Schedule: 40 hours per week, PST hours (flexible contract)

Employment Type: Contract

Compensation: Competitive hourly rate in USD, based on experience



About Adquadrant


Adquadrant is the AI-powered growth partner for modern consumer brands.


We help high-growth companies scale intelligently by transforming data, creative, and media into a connected intelligence system that learns and optimizes every day. Our approach unites four core pillars: Brand Intelligence, Media, Creative, and Measurement, all orchestrated through an AI framework that continuously adapts to performance signals and market shifts. At the center is Prism, Adquadrant’s AI intelligence engine that unifies data from every channel, identifies growth patterns, and powers real-time decision-making with precision and clarity. Through this connected model, we have helped next-generation brands generate over a billion dollars in attributable revenue and build lasting momentum in a constantly evolving market. The next era of growth is intelligent. Adquadrant builds the system behind it.


About the Role


We are seeking a Paid Media Campaign Manager who is comfortable managing cross-channel (Google, YouTube, Meta, TikTok, etc) paid media campaigns for US-based e-commerce and lead generation brands and is fanatical about AI usage to empower better and faster outcomes for clients.. You will handle day-to-day media execution across platforms, dive deep into performance data, and bring a test-and-learn mindset to every campaign.

This role is ideal for someone who is both a strategist and an operator, who thrives on solving complex performance challenges, enjoys building from 0 to 1, and knows how to connect data insights to creative opportunities.


Key Responsibilities


Campaign Management

  • Plan, launch, and optimize paid campaigns across Google Ads (Search, Pmax, Shopping, Display, YouTube), Meta/Instagram, TikTok, Pinterest,, and Microsoft Ads.
  • Manage and scale client budgets across multiple accounts, driving consistent ROAS and KPI achievement.
  • Analyze campaign data daily and adjust targeting, bidding, and creative to maximize performance.
  • Prepare performance reports using GA4, Looker Studio, Rockerbox, Supermetrics, and other attribution platforms.


Strategy & Innovation

  • Build and test strategies across new and emerging channels (e.G., Demand Gen, CTV, Retail Media).
  • Collaborate with creative and analytics teams to develop performance-driven media briefs.
  • Forecast and model potential performance outcomes using MMM, MTA, and cross-channel attribution data.


Client Collaboration

  • Partner closely with US-based teams and clients to align on objectives, budgets, and performance goals.
  • Present insights, strategic recommendations, and clear next steps in a client-facing capacity.
  • Proactively identify growth opportunities and communicate performance learnings.


Qualifications


  • 5+ years managing multi-channel paid media campaigns across both Paid Search and Paid Social.
  • Proven success optimizing toward ROAS, CPA, CPL, and revenue targets.
  • Experience managing large-scale budgets ($100K+/month) across multiple brands in the english speaking markets (US strongly preferred).
  • Proficiency with GA4, Rockerbox, Supermetrics, Looker Studio, or equivalent tools.
  • Understanding of forecasting, cross-channel attribution (MMM or MTA), and incrementality testing.
  • Strong analytical skills, with comfort translating data into actionable strategy.
  • Excellent written and spoken English;
    able to communicate clearly and professionally with US-based clients.
  • Detail-oriented, highly organized, and capable of managing multiple accounts independently.
  • Hands-on experience writing creative briefs and collaborating with creative teams.
  • Google Ads and Meta certifications preferred;
    TikTok, Pinterest, or certifications are a plus.


Ideal Candidate Profile


  • Managed $500K+ in monthly ad spend across a diverse portfolio of eCommerce clients.
  • Experience launching new channels or products from 0–1 with measurable success.
  • Skilled in reporting, visualization, and data storytelling through GA4 and Supermetrics.
  • Excels in environments that value data-driven decisions, intellectual curiosity, and collaboration.
  • Naturally curious, proactive, and eager to continuously test and learn.
  • Passionate about media innovation, AI-driven performance insights, and delivering measurable impact.

title: Design Director, Ui/Ux & Brand
description:
About Darkroom

Darkroom is a technology-driven growth marketing firm focused on growth-stage consumer companies. Founded in 2017, we build on a universal AI commerce layer called Matter, employing senior human resources enriched by an agentic technology stack to enhance output, efficiency, and revenue generation for our clients. Our team has delivered billions of dollars in trackable revenue across e‑commerce, direct-to-consumer, and social commerce programs, accelerating results through high‑impact digital strategies that unlock revenue growth, transform marketing operations, and prioritize profitability.

The Role

We are hiring a Design Director—a visionary leader with a strong design background, driving high‑quality design execution across various platforms and managing creative talent. You’ll combine strategic oversight with hands‑on involvement, ensuring every design project meets the highest standards of excellence.

Responsibilities
  • Lead 1–3 UI/UX engagements, focusing on branded e‑commerce websites.
  • Emphasize branded UI, conversion‑focused UX and clear design approaches.
  • Present design work to clients, explaining design choices based on effective reasoning and UX principles.
  • Manage design projects independently from discovery to hand‑off, adhering to timelines and collaborating with developers to ensure feasibility.
  • Develop component systems and maintain design guidelines for consistency.
  • Manage a team of designers, starting with 2–4 direct reports and expanding as the team grows;
    provide strategy, project management, design feedback, performance evaluation, and escalation handling.
  • Conduct weekly 1:1s with direct reports to assess client health, offer feedback and oversee career development.
  • Ensure high‑quality work output, focusing on visual craft, UX expertise and meeting deadlines.
  • Collaborate with cross‑functional teams—marketers, strategists, developers, and clients—to develop project plans, understand business objectives and address client issues.
  • Refine internal processes for client work in coordination with the Director of Creative;
    provide training and feedback to enhance the skills of the design team.
Qualifications
  • 3–6+ years of senior‑level web design experience with e‑commerce companies;
    at least 1 year of people‑management experience preferred.
  • Digital portfolio showcasing web design and branding skills—color theory, hierarchy, composition, typography.
  • Self‑motivated, proactive, detail‑oriented with strong sense of ownership.
  • Experience collaborating with developers and documenting designs for development hand‑off.
  • Comfortable with client‑facing responsibilities in English, leading discovery calls and resolving client feedback.
  • Ability to provide constructive internal feedback and guide direct reports.
  • Ability to tackle ambiguous problems, understand business challenges, design solutions and execute them effectively.
  • Proficiency in Figma (Auto Layout, Components, Variants) and Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator);
    bonus: familiarity with HTML/CSS or frameworks like Tailwind.
Remote & Compensation

Fully remote role operating in EST time zone, 100% conducted in English. Benefits include flexible parental leave, remote‑first culture, growth opportunities, autonomy with accountability, and a high‑bar performance environment.

Equal Opportunity

Darkroom is an equal‑opportunity workplace—dedicated to equal employment opportunities regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national orientation, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements.

You’ll combine strategic oversight with hands‑on involvement, ensuring that every design project meets the highest standards of excellence.

That role requires deep experience in branded UI/UX design. You’re a senior-level design lead that can independently own multiple web design engagements simultaneously. Navigating client feedback and pushback is an everyday muscle you successfully work with. You can show deep experience in being able to thread the needle between game‑changing UI, conversion‑oriented UX, and technical feasibility, all on a tight timeline. Clients are consistently impressed by your knowledge of e-commerce heuristics and how you combine that with unique and branded design. You love working with developers to understand how to make your ideas come to life and sell clients on design solutions and tradeoffs they have to make to complete engagements on‑time.

You pride yourself on being able to effortlessly spin up a new brand design system for a client that feels differentiated, elevated, and informed by your strategic market analysis. You have consistently merged business thinking with exceptional visual craft into scalable brand identities that work across paid media, retention, web, social, and packaging.

In addition to your individual contributor responsibilities, you will report to the Director of Creative and play a key role in guiding a talented team of designers, overseeing the delivery of exceptional designs for paid ads, emails, landing pages, and e-commerce web design. With your deep expertise in UI/UX and brand design, you’ll empower your team to elevate their skills while maintaining a high bar for creative output and attention to detail.

This role requires a balance of creativity, business strategy, and leadership in a fast-paced, collaborative environment. You’ll work closely with marketing, product, and development teams to ensure the alignment of design goals with broader business objectives. Your ability to drive creative strategy and manage multiple projects with precision will be essential to your success. Darkroom is a career incubator for ambitious talent looking to operate at the intersection of business, design, and innovation.

This is a fully remote role operating in the EST Time Zone and all business is conducted 100% in English.

Senior Individual Contributor Responsibilities:

  • Lead 1-3 UI/UX engagements as needed, focusing on creating branded e-commerce websites.

  • Emphasize branded UI, conversion‑focused UX, and clarity in design approaches.

  • Present design work to clients, explaining design choices based on effective reasoning and UX principles.

  • Manage design projects independently from discovery to hand‑off, adhering to timelines and collaborating with developers to ensure feasibility.

  • Develop component systems and maintain design guidelines for consistency.

Management Responsibilities:

  • Manage a team of designers, starting with 2-4 direct reports and expanding as the team grows. Provide support in strategy, project management, design feedback, performance evaluation, and handling escalations.

  • Conduct weekly 1:1s with direct reports to assess client health, offer feedback, and oversee career development.

  • Ensure high-quality work output from direct reports, focusing on visual craft, UX expertise, and meeting deadlines.

  • Collaborate with cross‑functional teams, including marketers, strategists, developers, and clients, to develop project plans, understand business objectives, and address client issues.

  • Refine internal processes for client work in coordination with the Director of Creative. Provide training and feedback to enhance the skills of the design team.

You Should Apply if this Sounds Like You:

  • 3-6+ years of senior‑level web design experience with e‑commerce companies, with at least 1 year of people management experience preferred. Must have experience in responsive web design.

  • Digital portfolio showcasing web design and branding skills, including color theory, hierarchy, composition, and typography.

  • Self‑motivated, proactive, and detail‑oriented with a strong sense of ownership.

  • Experience collaborating with developers and documenting designs for development hand‑off.

  • Comfortable with client‑facing responsibilities in English, including leading discovery calls and resolving client feedback.

  • Capable of providing constructive internal feedback and guiding direct reports to improve their work.

  • Ability to tackle ambiguous problems, understand business challenges, design solutions, and execute them effectively.

  • Proficiency in Figma, including features like Auto Layout, Components, and Variants, is essential.

  • Experience with Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator) is required.

  • Bonus: Familiarity with HTML/CSS or frameworks like Tailwind.

Working at Darkroom

Darkroom is not a typical agency. We are looking for A players that want to build something great. There is no room in our organization for mediocrity and candidates that are not at the top of their game do not last. We move fast, think deeply, and expect every team member to bring insight and rigor to everything they touch. We hold a high bar for performance, creativity, and ownership — but we also support each other relentlessly. No egos, no red tape — just world‑class talent building something remarkable.

We believe in autonomy with accountability , truth over comfort , and outcomes over optics . If you want to build and win alongside some of the smartest people in the business, you’ll thrive here.

  • Location, location, (or no) location: Remote‑first culture with a strong community base. With Hubs in the Bay Area, New York, Philly, Lisbon, Sao Paulo, and Barcelona!

  • Parental Leave: flexible parental leave benefits to support new parents during this important transition, ensuring time to bond with their families while maintaining work‑life balance.

  • Endless opportunities for growth: Our agency is founded on an interdisciplinary approach, giving Darkroomers insights into services far beyond your job description. Grow your skills and interests beyond your niche and stay at the forefront of the industry through total immersion in cross‑functional collaboration.

Equal Opportunity Statement

Darkroom is an equal opportunity workplace—we are dedicated to equal employment opportunities regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national orientation, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, or Veteran status. title: Analista De Contratos Sênior
description:
Analista de Contratos Sênior

Join to apply for the Analista de Contratos Sênior role at NTS - Nova Transportadora do Sudeste

A NTS (Nova Transportadora do Sudeste S/A – NTS) transporta gás natural por meio de um sólido sistema de gasodutos, conectando a região mais industrializada do Brasil com segurança e confiabilidade. São mais de 2.000 quilômetros de gasodutos ligando os estados do Rio de Janeiro, Minas Gerais e São Paulo ao gasoduto Bolívia‑Brasil, aos terminais de GNL e às plantas de processamento de gás.

Nossos Valores
  • Respeito à vida e ao meio ambiente: Nosso compromisso é com a segurança dos nossos funcionários e das comunidades e com a preservação do meio ambiente por onde passamos.
  • Integridade: Atuamos com transparência e comprometimento em todas nossas relações, nos pautando pela legalidade.
  • Foco em resultado: Não nos encantamos com sofisticações desnecessárias. Concentramos nossos esforços no alcance das metas e no foco em resultados.
  • Postura de dono: Olhar além do resultado imediato e tomar a melhor decisão para a empresa é uma atitude de todos os nossos funcionários.
Descrição da Vaga

Estamos em busca de um(a) Analista de Contratos para atuar na gestão contratual da Gerência de Engenharia e Gasodutos. Essa posição será responsável por acompanhar o ciclo completo dos contratos, desde a elaboração e controle de requisições até o acompanhamento de execução, medição, faturamento e encerramento, garantindo conformidade técnica, financeira e regulatória.

Responsabilidades
  • Gerenciar contratos da Gerência de Engenharia e Gasodutos, controlando saldos, prazos, cronogramas, escopos, desembolsos, aditivos, multas e cláusulas contratuais.
  • Elaborar e acompanhar Requisições de Compra (RCs) de serviços e materiais.
  • Revisar documentos técnicos como Memorial Descritivo (MD) e Planilha de Preços Unitários (PPU).
  • Acompanhar processos de compra junto à área de Suprimentos, assegurando fluxo de aprovações e avaliação técnica dos proponentes.
  • Conduzir reuniões de Kick-off (KOM) com contratadas.
  • Elaborar relatórios e dashboards de consumo contratual, prazos e status.
  • Realizar boletins de medição, consolidar evidências, controlar assinaturas, emitir SES e acompanhar faturamento e pagamento.
  • Atuar como interface técnica, jurídica e administrativa entre bases operacionais e áreas corporativas.
  • Realizar reuniões de acompanhamento contratual com fornecedores.
  • Garantir aderência orçamentária dos contratos sob sua responsabilidade.
  • Assegurar conformidade das contratadas às políticas de segurança e compliance da companhia.
Requisitos
  • Ensino superior completo em Administração, Engenharia de Produção, Comércio Exterior ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência prévia com gestão de contratos, compras e materiais, preferencialmente nos setores de óleo e gás ou infraestrutura.
  • Conhecimento em SAP ou sistemas similares de gestão de compras e contratos.
  • Excel avançado.
  • Boa comunicação, organização e capacidade de atuar com múltiplas interfaces.
  • Vivência com contratos de alta complexidade e gestão orçamentária.
  • Prontidão para resolução de problemas e tomada de decisão.
Diferencial
  • Conhecimento em Power BI e ferramentas de análise de dados.
  • Experiência com políticas de compliance e segurança aplicadas à gestão contratual.
Oferecemos
  • Ambiente de trabalho dinâmico e colaborativo.
  • Oportunidade de desenvolvimento e aprendizado contínuo.
  • Bolsa‑auxílio e benefícios compatíveis com o mercado: Cartão flexível Alimentação/Refeição, Plano de Saúde Bradesco Nacional e Odontológico Privian Master, Seguro de vida, Previdência Privada, Total Pass, Auxílio‑medicamentos pelo Vidalink, Vale‑presente, Vale‑transporte, Ticket de Natal, Auxílio creche/babá e PLR.
Como se preparar para o processo seletivo
  • Pesquise sobre a NTS: Entenda a história, valores e missão da NTS. Visite o site oficial e leia notícias recentes.
  • Revisão de CV: Garanta que seu currículo esteja atualizado e reflita suas habilidades e experiências relevantes.
  • Prepare‑se para perguntas: Pense em exemplos concretos de situações em que demonstrou suas habilidades e competências.
  • Conheça a vaga: Entenda as responsabilidades e requisitos da posição para alinhar suas respostas às expectativas da empresa.
Etapas do Processo Seletivo
  • Entrevista com time de Gente: Para discutir mais sobre a empresa, aderência à vaga e expectativas.
  • Entrevista com o Gestor: Para conversar sobre aspectos do dia a dia, conhecimento técnico e carreira.
  • Entrevista com as Interfaces: Coordenadores e clientes internos que terão contato próximo com a área.
  • Entrevista com os Coordenadores ou Gerentes da área: Última etapa para conhecer a liderança e alinhar expectativas finais.
Por que trabalhar conosco?

Na NTS, você encontra um ambiente dinâmico, inclusivo e acolhedor, onde as pessoas são valorizadas e têm espaço para crescer. Acreditamos no poder da diversidade, da colaboração e do desenvolvimento contínuo.

Oferecemos oportunidades reais de aprendizado e evolução profissional, com programas estruturados e incentivo ao protagonismo de carreira.

Nosso pacote de benefícios é completo e pensado para cuidar de você em todas as fases da vida:

  • Plano de saúde de qualidade.
  • Previdência privada.
  • Vale refeição/alimentação (Swile).
  • Auxílio farmácia.
  • Auxílio creche.
  • Day‑off de aniversário.
  • TotalPass.
  • Participação nos Lucros e Resultados (PLR).

title: Technical Assistant
description:
Result of Service

The Technical Assistant reports to the Head of Brazil Office. He/She shall duly and timely perform his/her obligations, under these Terms of Reference. The consultant will work in close collaboration with the UN-Habitat's operational and technical teams.

Work Location

Rio de Janeiro, Brazil

Expected duration

Three (3) months, with possibility of renewal

Duties and Responsibilities

Background The main mandate of the United Nations Human Settlements Programme (UN-Habitat) is to promote sustainable development of human settlements and policies conducive to adequate housing for all. Within this framework, UN-Habitat supports central and state governments, as well as local authorities and other partners, for the implementation of the Habitat Agenda, the 2030 Agenda with the Sustainable Development Goals and the New Urban Agenda. UN-Habitat helps the urban poor by transforming cities into safer, more inclusive, compact, integrated, resilient and connected places with better opportunities where everyone can live with dignity. It works with organizations at every level, including all spheres of government, civil society, and the private sector to help build, manage, plan and finance sustainable urban development. The Regional Office for Latin American and the Caribbean – ROLAC – is based in Rio de Janeiro, Brazil. The Agency puts emphasis in developing and managing activities in the host country. Indeed, for the past years, UN-Habitat has expanded its portfolio in Brazil by working with the three tiers of government to support the formulation and implementation of more effective, sustainable, participative, and socially fairer urban economic, social, and environmental policies. To expand the programme and seek support to work with the challenges of reducing urban poverty and integrating all segments of the population into the fabric of the city, UN-Habitat is a partner of Instituto Pereira Passos (IPP) of the Municipality of Rio de Janeiro (PCRJ) in the implementation of the Social Territories Programme. To respect, protect and achieve rights and build a fairer and more equitable city, the Social Territories Programme aims to identify the most vulnerable urban population of the city of Rio de Janeiro, better understand their living conditions and promote a specialized support to integrate them into public registries, the network of basic services and the municipal urban fabric. The Social Territories Programme has been implemented, since 2019, first in large favela complexes (Alemão, Chapadão, Cidade de Deus, Lins, Maré, Pedreira, Penha, Jacarezinho, Rocinha and Vila Kennedy), and currently in larger scale throughout the city. To properly continue the Social Territories Programme's implementation, a Technical Assistant is required to support Programme activities in designated areas of the city. Report to UN-Habitat Manager The Technical Assistant reports to the Head of Brazil Office, who will evaluate him/her. Responsibilities The Technical Assistant will support the implementation of the programme and its activities, with the following responsibilities: a) Provide support and orientation to the Programme's families and individuals selected for monitoring under Rio de Janeiro's social policies. b) Provide support and orientation to the Programme's families and individuals selected for monitoring during household visitations in designated territories. c) Access information about families and individuals selected for monitoring using the Integrated Assistance Protocols and other public databases and refer them to the appropriate public agencies. d) Research complementary information about families and individuals selected for monitoring and forward them to the appropriate public agencies. e) Work in partnership with civil servants in several municipal agencies (Education, Social Assistance, Health, and so on) to increase access to public services for families and individuals selected for monitoring. f) Provide input for the identification and mitigation of bottlenecks within the Integrated Assistance Protocols. g) Maintain professional and cordial relations with the Programme's counterparts. h) Disseminate updated information about the Programme within designated territories. i) Ensure that the Programme's technical activities within the purview of his or her function are aligned with the Agency's and its counterparts' quality expectations. j) Perform other duties which may be requested. The consultant will be responsible for completing all courses and training activities that are indicated to him/her by his/her supervisor. The security course BSAFE, from UNDSS, is required to be accredited during the first month of employment. The consultant will be responsible for his/her own security, so the person should get familiarized with United Nations security mechanisms and comply with them according to the Framework of Accountability for the United Nations Security Management System. Outputs/Work Assignment The Technical Assistant will support the implementation of the Programme's work plan and daily activities. The consultant shall be paid a monthly allowance upon presentation and approval by the Head of Brazil Office of monthly activities' report.

Qualifications/special skills

Education Required:
• High School Diploma is required or additional two (2) years of relevant experience to the post, beyond the requirement. Desired:
• Bachelor's degree in Social Work, Psychology, Education or related fields. Work experience:
• Minimum four (4) years of experience in assisting families in situations of social vulnerability is required.
• Knowledge of the National Social Assistance Policy is required.
• Experience with the Programme's target communities is required.
• Previous experience working in the United Nations is desirable. Skills:
• Good handling of technological tools is required.
• Good computer skills in Windows, such as Microsoft Office and Microsoft Excel, is desirable. Competencies
• Professionalism: Experience working in an inter-institutional environment, project management, monitoring-evaluation; approaches and strategies regarding good urban governance and local and regional development.
• Planning and organization: Professional approach to work, strong sense of responsibility, operate with minimal supervision; proven organizational skills and ability to manage a workload efficiently and within set deadlines.
• Communication: Ability to write clearly and effectively; listen to others, interpret messages correctly and respond appropriately; show openness in information sharing and keep everyone informed; solid abstract reasoning skills together with a proven capacity to write documents for diverse audiences.
• Teamwork: Ability to work with teams, demonstrate leadership, conflict management and consensus facilitation skills; ability to work in a multicultural and multi-ethnic environment, and to respect diversity; sensitivity to the main streaming of vulnerability; willingness and ability to work in difficult environments. Knowledge Management
• The person must know the processes, procedures, and norms of UN-Habitat, to guarantee an adequate quality of the activities described above, following the standards of the organization.
• The person will propose formats and procedures that allow the efficient implementation of the activities related to the project development.
• The person must know the file of the Office, work with it, and ensure its proper maintenance, accessibility for all staff, and due updating.
• The person will prepare databases related to the project running.
• The person will make sure that all relevant technical information will be adequately shared with the correspondent staff.
• The person will ensure that all produced material will be fit-for-purpose and delivered, in an organized way, for posterior consultation and use of the Agency.
• The person will only share the information produced with the team agency, assuring the privacy of the content.

Languages


• English and French are the working languages of the United Nations Secretariat, and Spanish is the working language of the Regional Office.
• For the post advertised, fluency in Portuguese is required. Working knowledge of any other working language of the United Nations is desirable.

Additional Information

Travel details: Not applicable. Remuneration SB-2/4 – BRL: 4.465,88 (net amount) UNDP Brazil Salary Scale Notes Appointment against this post is on local basis and only nationals from Brazil or external candidates who hold a permanent visa in Brazil may apply. The extension of this contract is subject to availability of funds and/or performance. Any contract extension is not automatic. It is required for all the curricular information to be inserted in the system, which may take a few hours. Only complete applications in English will be considered. All applications will be treated with the strictest confidence. Due to the volume of applications received, receipt of applications cannot be acknowledged individually. Only short-listed applicants will be contacted. Applications should be submitted through INSPIRA and must include all documents required at the system, please be ready to include the following information at the "Candidate Profile" (CP) at Inspira:
• Cover memo (maximum 1 page)
• Educational Background (incl. dates)
• Professional Experience (assignments, tasks, achievements, duration by years/ months)
• Expertise and preferences regarding location of potential assignments
• Other Experience and Expertise (e.g. Internships/voluntary work, etc.) * * Please note that Internships, self-employment and part-time count as 50%. In addition to it, note experience not relevant to the position will not be considered. All applications should be submitted to: Inspira UN-HABITAT does not charge a fee at any stage of the recruitment process. If you have any questions concerning people or companies claiming to be recruiting on behalf of these offices and requesting the payment of a fee, please contact:

title: pessoa especialista em ia
description:
AQUI SUA CARREIRA COMEÇA GRANDE.

VENHA SER UMA PESSOA ESPECIALISTA EM IA NA YDUQS.

Temos um projeto grandioso e que requer um time com disposição para pensar de forma original, disruptiva, e com objetivo de resolver as grandes questões de hoje na educação: acesso, tecnologia, customização e o sucesso dos nossos alunos.

Somos uma companhia cheia de energia, que já nasceu gigante e com resultados extraordinários.

Venha fazer parte desse time

VENHA TRANSFORMAR VIDAS. INCLUSIVE A SUA.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

Aqui, você não vai só "codar". Vai criar soluções inteligentes que transformam negócios. Estamos buscando alguém apaixonado por tecnologia, automação e inovação, que queira aplicar IA de ponta para resolver problemas reais, gerar impacto e acelerar resultados.

Se você gosta de unir engenharia, ciência e criatividade, esse é o lugar certo.

Os principais desafios como PESSOA ESPECIALISTA EM IA são:

  • Criar e evoluir aplicações e automações inteligentes com IA e LLMs, do protótipo ao produto em escala.
  • Garantir que nossas soluções sejam robustas, escaláveis e de alta performance.
  • Ser referência técnica no time, compartilhando conhecimento e inspirando inovação.
  • Trabalhar lado a lado com engenharia, dados, design e negócio para cocriar produtos digitais de impacto.
  • Trazer e testar novas ideias, frameworks e tecnologias — afinal, experimentação faz parte do jogo.
  • Apoiar a evolução contínua da nossa arquitetura e práticas de engenharia.

Requisitos e qualificações

Buscamos profissionais com:

  • Formação em áreas de tecnologia (Ciência da Computação, Eng. de Software, etc.).
  • +5 anos de experiência em desenvolvimento ou engenharia de software.
  • Experiência com desenvolvimento em Python (e se você domina outras linguagens, melhor ainda).
  • Conhecimento sólido em IA/ML/LLMs (PyTorch, TensorFlow, Scikit-learn, LangChain, etc.).
  • Vivência com cloud (AWS, Azure ou GCP) e deploy de soluções em escala.
  • Experiência com CI/CD, automação de testes e boas práticas de engenharia.
  • Capacidade de traduzir tecnologia em valor de negócio e colaborar com diferentes áreas.

Desejável:

  • Experiência em MLOps e automação do ciclo de vida de modelos.
  • Atuação prévia em startups, labs de inovação ou P&D.
  • Conhecimento em arquiteturas modernas (serverless, orientadas a eventos).
  • Participação em comunidades, publicações ou projetos open-source de IA.

Por que se juntar a nós?

  • Você terá espaço para inovar, experimentar e impactar de verdade.
  • Vai trabalhar com tecnologias de ponta em IA e resolver desafios complexos.
  • Ambiente colaborativo, com autonomia, troca de conhecimento e foco em crescimento constante.
  • Um time que respira inovação e acredita que a tecnologia pode mudar a forma como os negócios acontecem.

Seu desafio: construir o futuro com IA.

Se você curte resolver problemas complexos, experimentar sem medo e criar soluções que geram impacto, essa vaga é pra você.

Informações adicionais

Local de Trabalho: Híbrido, Barra da Tijuca - Rio de Janeiro.

Jornada de trabalho: 40 horas semanais, de segunda a sexta-feira, das 9h às 18h, com opção de flexibilidade das 8h às 17h.

Na YDUQS você vai encontrar:

  • Bolsas de estudo de até 100% para colaboradores, dependentes legais e agregados (pai, mãe e irmãos (as). Permitindo até três bolsas simultâneas;
  • Assistência médica com subsídio integral para o colaborador e parcial para sua família, com o colaborador responsável pela coparticipação;
  • Assistência odontológica opcional, para cuidar da sua saúde bucal;
  • Vale Alimentação ou Vale Refeição com opção de escolha para se adequar às suas necessidades;
  • Wellhub ou Totalpass para opções flexíveis de academias;
  • Wellz uma plataforma voltada para a saúde mental e emocional dos colaboradores que oferece diversos tipos de acompanhamento, dentre eles acesso a terapias online individuais
  • Bem-estar e clube de vantagens com programa dedicado e vantagens exclusivas;
  • Dress code flexível para promover a nossa diversidade;
  • Seguro de vida;
  • Convênio com o SESC;
  • Universidade Corporativa no nosso portal exclusivo, Educare;
  • Oportunidades de crescimento, hoje mais de 60% das vagas são fechadas com processo de seleção interno.

Modelo de trabalho híbrido para todos os escritórios corporativos da companhia.

Horário Flexível, contamos com política de Horário Flexível para colaboradores administrativos do corporativo, com opções de jornada dentro das faixas definidas pela companhia, inclusive para o home office.

Trabalho remoto (home office) estendido para as mães recém-chegadas da licença maternidade por até 3 meses, de acordo com a função desenvolvida.

Acreditamos na excelência do nosso ensino e, por isso, valorizamos os egressos das nossas instituições em nossos processos seletivos.

Compromisso com a inclusão: todas as nossas vagas também são destinadas a pessoas com deficiência, reforçando o quanto valorizamos a diversidade

DIVERSIDADE: A YDUQS valoriza a diversidade e as informações adicionais prestadas nos campos de diversidade são muito importantes para nós, por isso pedimos para que não deixe de responder.

Já pensou em transformar a sociedade por meio da educação? Então, vem pra Yduqs

Aqui, a tecnologia faz parte do nosso core business : unimos a educação ao nosso ecossistema de transformação digital para impactar diariamente mais de 1,2 milhão de alunos

Desde 2018, estamos em processo contínuo de melhoria e virtualização da experiência administrativa dos alunos de nossas instituições. Em 2022, lançamos o nosso programa de inovação aberta, o Yduqs Labs, que busca gerar negócio com startups já em fase de tração para desenvolvimento de soluções aos nossos desafios corporativos.

Já somos conhecidos como um dos principais articuladores de inovação do setor e, dentro de casa, reforçamos nosso hub de pesquisa e conteúdo para o ensino digital, do qual já fazem parte as edtechs EnsineMe, Qconcursos e Hardwork Medicina.

Somos o maior grupo de educação superior no Brasil e uma das organizações que mais inova e cresce no país. Temos o objetivo de promover um salto de qualidade para o ensino superior no Brasil. Oferecemos educação de qualidade para pessoas de todas as classes sociais, em todo o país, e ao longo de toda a sua vida adulta.

MISSÃO

Educar para transformar.

VISÃO

Transformar a educação no Brasil a partir do uso intenso de tecnologia para apoiar o desenvolvimento de jovens e adultos de todas as classes, do Oiapoque ao Chuí, com práticas sustentáveis para todos os nossos públicos.

VALORES

Foco no aluno

Todos nós trabalhamos para o aluno, temos paixão por educar.

Senso de dono e resultado

Agimos como donos, entregamos resultado em equipe.

Qualidade

Oferecemos experiência educacional única para todos, com uso intenso de tecnologia.

Pessoas

Sentimos orgulho em trabalhar aqui e acreditamos em meritocracia.

Inovação e simplicidade

O novo nos atrai, soluções simples também.

Diversidade e ética

Fazemos o certo, valorizamos as diferenças e a diversidade.

UNIDADES DE NEGÓCIO

A organização está estruturada em três divisões de negócios: presencial, digital e premium. Dentro da vertical Digital, temos a EnsineMe, unidade de conteúdos e metodologias digitais, que coloca a Yduqs na dianteira da pesquisa, desenvolvimento e produção de conhecimento para nossos cursos. Além disso, contamos com uma equipe corporativa multidisciplinar, que reúne, entre outras atividades, as de Finanças, Marketing, TI e Gente & Gestão.

NOSSAS INSTITUIÇÕES DE ENSINO

Ibmec - IDOMED - Estácio - Damásio Educacional - Clio - SJT - Qconcursos - Wyden: UniToledo, UniFacid, UniFanor, UniFBV, UniRuy, Faculdade Martha Falcão, UniFavip, UniMetrocamp, Facimp e Faci.

O QUE VOCÊ VAI ENCONTRAR POR AQUI?

Contamos com profissionais que valorizam a inovação em um ambiente diverso, com simplicidade e ética. Nossas iniciativas sempre têm o aluno no centro da decisão, pois consideramos o seu sucesso como nosso.

Com uma forte apropriação da cultura digital, atuamos por meio do desenvolvimento de metodologias e de conteúdos que refletem os desafios e as necessidades do nosso tempo.

Temos um grupo de alta liderança extremamente sênior e competente, que nos guia com segurança sobre a estratégia da organização.

Estamos dedicados em contribuir para redução do problema estratégico de Diversidade & Inclusão no país, implementando um programa estruturado e colocando o tema constantemente em pauta com a alta liderança.

Somos vidrados no engajamento dos colaboradores e implementamos um programa estruturado de eNPS, com 5 squads rodando em paralelo com foco em melhoria contínua na experiência do colaborador. Em 3 meses de lançamento já implementamos 14 melhorias focadas em oportunidade de carreira e infra digital.

Valorizamos a meritocracia e, como prova disso, 61% das nossas vagas foram fechadas com colaboradores internos em 2022.

A BCP DTVM é uma instituição financeira voltada para originação, estruturação e distribuição de ativos financeiros, com destaque para crédito privado e operações estruturadas. Nossa atuação inclui uma mesa ativa de negociações no mercado secundário, promovendo liquidez e transparência para os clientes.

Expandindo do mercado offshore para o mercado local, a BCP DTVM combina expertise técnica e agilidade, atendendo empresas, investidores institucionais e family offices com soluções sólidas e inovadoras. title: Customer Trainer Latin America
description:
Company Description
At Intuitive, we are united behind our mission: we believe that minimally invasive care is life-enhancing care. Through ingenuity and intelligent technology, we expand the potential of physicians to heal without constraints.

As pioneer and leading company in the field of robotic-assisted surgery, we strive to foster an inclusive and diverse team, committed to making a difference. For more than 25 years, we have worked with hospitals and care teams around the world to help solve some of healthcare's hardest challenges and advance what is possible.

Intuitive has been built by the efforts of great people from diverse backgrounds. We believe great ideas can come from anywhere—we strive to foster an inclusive culture built around diversity of thought and mutual respect. We lead with inclusion and empower our team members to do their best work as their most authentic selves.

Passionate people who want to make a difference drive our culture—our team members are grounded in integrity, have a strong capacity to learn, the energy to get things done, and bring diverse, real-world experiences to help us think in new ways. We actively invest in our team members to support their long-term growth so they can continue to advance our mission and achieve their highest potential.

Join a team committed to taking big leaps forward for a global community of healthcare professionals and their patients. Together, let's advance the world of minimally invasive care.

Job Description
Primary Function of Position:
The Customer Trainer will report directly to the Senior Manager or Training Manager for their region. This training professional will deliver da Vinci System technology training and facilitate surgeon-led training for surgeons, first assistants, and OR staff from a variety of surgical specialties including urology, gynecology, general surgery thoracic and Trans-oral surgery. The Customer Trainer will be actively involved in the continuous improvement of training programs and provide support for customer training, engineering, and training research initiatives.

Roles And Responsibilities

  • Conduct da Vinci and Ion training programs for surgeons, physicians, and their care teams at designated training centers and remote centers
  • Lead and support Specialized training programs and Society events
  • This includes supporting the needs of the surgeon educators and course participants Conduct surveys to gather data and measure program effectiveness
  • Act as subject matter expert for internal projects, as needed
  • New product development Training material/ protocol development
  • Training research initiatives Work with the Training team in a creative, dependable, and flexible manner to improve existing training programs
  • Train the sales force to conduct in-services and system technology skills development activities with customers on new and established products
  • Occasional support of the da Vinci System in a hospital operating room
  • Support da Vinci Surgical System troubleshooting and maintenance at the training center
  • Manage training center logistics, inventory and training calendars
  • Maintain all capital equipment, including but not limited to the cleaning and sterilization of instruments and accessories
  • Support positive relationships between external training center personnel and ISI management
  • Contribute to the organization's quarterly goal achievements
  • Develop competency in the following: da Vinci System and Ion Technology, da Vinci System applications and advanced technology, OR Efficiency, Training Pathway process
  • Act as a Medical Device Consultant (Medizinprodukteberater) in Austria and Germany, after appropriate training, as per legal requirement and provide guidance, insight, and support in the proper handling of Intuitive medical devices
  • Maintaining competency and currency on technology training protocol following the onboarding program guidelines, and annual competency check
  • Training/coaching techniques/methodologies
  • Travel required

Qualifications
Required Knowledge, Skills, and Experience:

  • Professional Training experience preferred
  • Clinical and/or operating room experience preferred
  • High capacity and excellent problem-solving skills
  • Solid organizational skills and ability to operate independently
  • Professional work ethic
  • Solution oriented
  • Excellent oral and written communication skills
  • Strong interpersonal skills
  • Knowledge of adult learning principles preferred
  • High capacity to learn in a fast-paced environment
  • Medical-device experience preferred
  • Commitment to self-development
  • Ability to work in a team environment
  • Ability to be flexible with hours of operation

Additional Information

Intuitive is an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer. We provide equal employment opportunities to all qualified applicants and employees, and prohibit discrimination and harassment of any type, without regard to race, sex, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, color, age, religion, protected veteran or disability status, genetic information or any other status protected under federal, state, or local applicable laws.

We will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records in accordance with fair chance laws.

title: Técnico de Segurança do Trabalho
description:
Técnico de Segurança do Trabalho - SST

Descrição da Vaga:
Estamos em busca de um Técnico de Segurança do Trabalho organizado, analítico e comprometido com a saúde e segurança no ambiente corporativo. O profissional ideal possui habilidades técnicas e comportamentais que garantam a execução eficiente de tarefas relacionadas à gestão de SST, além de colaborar com a equipe para promover um ambiente de trabalho seguro e em conformidade com a legislação vigente.

Este profissional também atuará diretamente no atendimento a um cliente do ramo do varejo, realizando visitas em lojas para execução de atividades de campo, como: DDS, treinamentos, CIPA, emissão de CAT, rondas de segurança, gestão e entrega de EPIs, entre outras ações preventivas e corretivas.

Horário de Trabalho:

  • Segunda a quinta-feira: 07h às 17h
  • Sexta-feira: 07h às 16h
  • Carga horária semanal: 44h (220h mensais).

Descrição da Função:

  • Apoiar no levantamento de dados e na organização de informações técnicas para elaboração, renovação e atualização de laudos (LTI, LTP, LTCAT);
  • Elaborar, revisar e manter atualizados os documentos legais obrigatórios de SST, como PGR, PCMSO, PPP, PCA, PPR, entre outros;
  • Controlar prazos de validade de documentos e laudos, assegurando sua conformidade com as exigências legais;
  • Atuar na gestão documental e no arquivamento físico e digital de registros relacionados à Saúde e Segurança do Trabalho;
  • Dar suporte em auditorias internas e externas, organizando evidências e documentações exigidas;
  • Desenvolver relatórios, planilhas e indicadores gerenciais voltados para a área de SST;
  • Apoiar na comunicação com fornecedores de serviços técnicos e na coleta de informações para contratos e relatórios;
  • Contribuir com a padronização e melhoria contínua dos processos administrativos relacionados à SST;
  • Realizar visitas técnicas em campo para conduzir treinamentos, DDS, CIPA, CAT, rondas de segurança e atividades relacionadas à entrega e controle de EPIs.

Requisitos:

  • Curso Técnico em Segurança do Trabalho completo, com registro ativo no MTE;
  • Experiência anterior com foco em rotinas administrativas da área de SST;
  • Conhecimento prático em elaboração de documentos legais e laudos técnicos;
  • Familiaridade com Normas Regulamentadoras e sistemas de gestão de SST;
  • Boa comunicação escrita, organização e domínio de ferramentas como Word, Excel e plataformas de gestão documental;
  • Será um diferencial experiência com sistemas como SOC ou similares.

Competências Comportamentais:

  • Organização e planejamento estratégico;
  • Proatividade e foco em soluções práticas;
  • Atenção aos detalhes e pensamento analítico;
  • Comunicação assertiva e clareza na transmissão de informações;
  • Trabalho em equipe e habilidade para influenciar positivamente os colaboradores;
  • Comprometimento com ética e normas profissionais.

Outros Benefícios:

  • TotalPass: acesso a mais de 20 mil academias parceiras em todo o Brasil;
  • Convênio SESC;
  • Descontos em instituições de ensino parceiras;
  • Swile Vale Refeição, cartão de benefícios flexíveis.

title: executivo comercial
description:
Descrição da vaga

Você está se candidatando a uma das vagas disponíveis na Rede Américas. Nosso time de Atração e Seleção vai analisar seu perfil com atenção e, se estiver alinhado com a vaga, entraremos em contato para seguir com o processo. Enquanto isso, mantenha suas informações atualizadas e conclua todas as etapas, assim, podemos te conhecer melhor.

Importante: não efetuamos cobranças de taxas em nossos processos seletivos

Responsabilidades e atribuições

Sobre a posição: Um executivo comercial hospitalar é o responsável por expandir e manter a carteira de clientes do hospital, negociando contratos com operadoras de saúde, empresas e outros prestadores, além de analisar o mercado, desenvolver estratégias comerciais e garantir o alinhamento com outras áreas da instituição para otimizar a receita e a eficiência. As responsabilidades incluem a prospecção ativa de novos negócios, a gestão de relacionamento com clientes existentes, a elaboração de propostas e a análise de indicadores comerciais e operacionais.

Principais Responsabilidades

  • Prospecção e Negociação: Buscar e fechar novos contratos com operadoras de saúde, empresas e outros parceiros para ampliar a base de clientes e a utilização dos serviços hospitalares.
  • Gestão de Contratos e Relacionamento: Manter um relacionamento próximo e estratégico com operadoras, empresas e corretores, garantindo a satisfação e fidelização dos parceiros.
  • Análise de Mercado e Desempenho: Monitorar o desempenho comercial e operacional, analisar indicadores e gerar relatórios para a gestão.
  • Desenvolvimento de Estratégias: Desenvolver e implementar estratégias comerciais, incluindo campanhas e iniciativas para a otimização de receitas.
  • Colaboração Interdepartamental: Trabalhar em conjunto com as áreas assistencial, marketing, jurídico, faturamento e cadastro para garantir a entrega alinhada às propostas comerciais e resolver pendências com convênios.
  • Análise de Precificação: Apoiar a análise e a melhoria do processo de precificação de procedimentos e a gestão da receita líquida contratada e realizada.
  • Participação em Eventos: Participar de eventos, reuniões e feiras para ampliar o conhecimento do mercado, gerar leads e promover a unidade hospitalar.

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Cursando Ensino superior.
  • Conhecimento em Excel.

title: Quality Control Analyst
description:
About Us

Airswift is the leading workforce solutions provider to the STEM industries. For over 40 years Airswift has been transforming lives through the provision of international workforce solutions to STEM industries. Today, we are an integrated team of over 900 employees across 37 countries, supporting over 8,000 contractors globally.

We are a people business – we transform lives through the world of work. We care about wellbeing, community engagement and our planet – we plant a tree for every person placed in a job globally We have a passion for growth, including investing in the development of our people.

We support professionals looking for jobs with exceptional firms in the technology, construction, and engineering sectors.

Role Description

The Quality Control Team play a critical role in maintaining data quality across the business. Data is at the core of our operations, and it is essential that this data is of a high standard at all times. The QC Analyst will work as part of the Commercial Team to drive data accuracy across the region, as well as being a part of the Global QC Team, sharing best practices, improvement initiatives and maintaining consistency across all regions. Attention to detail is paramount and strong communication skills are essential as there will be significant collaboration with other departments, in particular with the Recruitment and Service Teams.

Principle Accountabilities:

  • Review Bullhorn records within the agreed timeframes and issue approval or query notes as appropriate. This may include Contract Placements, Change Requests, Perm/Direct Hire placements, GEM Placements, Client Records, Opportunity Records and Requirement Records.
  • Work with the relevant parties to ensure that any errors are corrected in a timely manner.
  • Produce reporting and analysis to provide key stakeholders with an accurate and up to date view of data accuracy across the region.
  • Hold regular QC review meetings with relevant departments to discuss any issues and identify key areas for improvement.
  • Collaborate with other QC Coordinators, both regionally and globally, to share best practices and drive process improvement, in particular to deal with interregional placements efficiently.
  • Take a proactive approach to data clean-up e.g., updating fields in Bullhorn when a staff member leaves.
  • Support the QA/PIs with QC related process improvement projects.
  • Special adhoc projects, as directed by the Commercial Operations Manager.
  • Liaise closely with Payroll & Billing to ensure contract compliance relating to payroll and invoicing.
  • Work closely with Sales Team to ensure quality and contract compliance.
  • Ensure that Bullhorn and any relevant trackers are updated accordingly.

Skills, Knowledge, and Experience:

  • Fluent English.
  • Bachelor's degree preferred.
  • Excellent technical skills including all Microsoft Office products.
  • Strong numerical skills.
  • Ability to problem solve.
  • Attention to detail.
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
  • Ability to make decisions and prioritise objectives.
  • Must be a self-starter and able to work without supervision.
  • Able to handle demanding situations.

What we can offer you

  • Attractive monthly base salary + competitive commission/performance bonus.
  • Genuine career progression opportunities, either locally or globally
  • World-class training programmes and development opportunities.
  • Virtual Onboarding Events exclusively for new hires.
  • Team driven environment, supportive culture with a focus on work-life balance.
  • Career breaks available after one year.
  • Real time recognition through our employee reward platform.
  • Mental Health First Aiders to signpost you to support when you need it.
  • Yearly destination trips as part of our High Flyers program (Dubai, Buenos Aires, etc…)
  • Charity days for various important causes such as Relay for Life and Earth Day.

Our Core Values:

  • Growth
  • In life and business, one must grow to flourish and achieve high ambitions. Growth
    requires change, challenge, risk and sacrifice - we will always choose growth.
  • Life
    – Above all else, we value life. The quality of life, both in and outside of work, profoundly influences our well-being and our impact on the world.
  • Excellence
  • We deliver, holding ourselves accountable for results. Our customers see excellence in everything we do.
  • Integrity
  • We are ethical, open, honest and authentic. People trust us to do the right thing for the right reason.

Visit our website and social media to find out more -

Disclaimer

They are not to be construed as an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, duties, and skills required of personnel so classified. All personnel may be required to perform duties outside of their normal responsibilities from time to time, as needed.

Diversity & Inclusion

At Airswift, we believe that diversity is critical to our success and makes us a great place to work. We are committed to building an equal opportunity workplace, the more inclusive we are - the better our work will be.

description:

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Atuar nas atividades relacionadas a gestão de ativos, no controle e melhorias dos ativos de geração com 6 usinas fotovoltaica com 186MW;
  • Desenvolver e gerenciar no monitoramento das condições dos ativos, visando a preservação, disponibilidade e confiabilidade dos ativos;
  • Indicadores: elaborar, analisar e acompanhar os indicadores de desempenho, PR (Performance Ratio), EPI (Energy Performance Index), disponibilidade, perdas energéticas, Energia Esperada (P50 e via PVSyst), dados meteorológicos, energia gerada, manutenção preventiva e corretiva, entre outros;
  • Análise de Falha: realizar os estudos relacionados as ocorrências de falha, identificar a causa raiz e propor soluções. Classificação de falhas por ativo: inversores, trackers, combiner box, cabos e módulos fotovoltaicos, entre outros;
  • Confiabilidade: análise preditiva, desenvolver FMEA (Análise de Modos de Falha e seus Efeitos)/RCM (Manutenção Centrada na Confiabilidade);
  • Melhoria Contínua: sugerir/participar de iniciativas de melhoria de processos/procedimentos/sistemas considerando o desempenho, custo e risco;
  • Geração e análise de relatórios periódicos de desempenho e manutenção por ativo, contemplando revisões mensais, semestrais e anuais de divulgação;
  • Responder e elaborar controle de acompanhamento das demandas do ONS (SGP, Relatórios) e ANEEL (Ofícios);
  • Interação com a equipe de campo de O&M, fornecedores e fabricantes;
  • Contribuir para obtenção de resultado, através de sinergia com as demais áreas da empresa. Respeitando os parâmetros de segurança e de meio ambiente;
  • Outras atividades delegadas pela coordenação/gerência pertinentes ao cargo.

Requisitos e qualificações

Necessário:

  • Ensino Superior completo em Engenharias (Preferencialmente em Engenharia Elétrica – Sistema de Potência)
  • Conhecimento em ativos de geração de energia renovável fotovoltaico (GC - Geração Centralizada)
  • Conhecimento em Confiabilidade.
  • Ferramenta Power BI – Intermediário.
  • Conhecimento PVSyst – Intermediário.
  • Pacote Office – Intermediário.
  • Idioma Espanhol: Básico

Diferenciais:

  • Carteira Nacional de Habilitação B.

Somos uma empresa que participa no desenvolvimento, investimento e gestão de ativos de infraestrutura.

Nossa filosofia baseia-se em:

Capacidade de gerar fluxo de caixa previsíveis a longo prazo.

Melhorar a sustentabilidade do mercado.

Nossos ativos estão centrados majoritariamente na transmissão e na geração de energia renovável no âmbito de programas de parceria público-privada.

title: Global Mobility
description:
Vialto Partners is a market leader in global mobility services. Our purpose is to 'Connect the world'. We are unique and the only stand-alone global mobility business. This presents a rare opportunity for our clients, stakeholders and colleagues.

Our teams help companies streamline and effectively manage their global mobility programs in a cost-efficient and compliant manner. Our services focus on providing cross-border compliance and risk assessment for tax, immigration, business travel, rewards and compensation, and remote work.

Working at Vialto Partners is about getting the chance to be part of a global and dynamic team. Globally, Vialto Partners has over 6,500 staff in over 50 countries around the world, and continues to grow. You will work with clients from a range of industries and different geographical locations. We believe in connecting the world and supporting our colleagues to do the same in their careers by undertaking assignments and opportunities globally that broaden their skills and ultimately benefit our clients.

Vialto is unstoppable when we work together in a culture of belonging, where everyone can thrive. We encourage employees to bring their true selves and share their unique talents and expertise to positively impact the communities we serve.

To learn more about what we do, tune in to our podcast On the Move to hear expert insights on issues affecting global mobility, and read about the latest news in the industry. You can also follow us on Linkedin and Instagram.

Job Description
As a Senior Associate, you will work as part of a team of problem solvers with extensive tax and consulting experience, helping our clients meet their individual income tax compliance obligations. You will address complex tax issues from strategy to execution, ensuring a smooth and efficient process. Building trusted relationships and fostering team success are essential parts of this role.

Responsibilities for this position include but are not limited to:

  • Assist clients in their individual income tax compliance obligations, including preparation of individual income tax computations and returns, and handling correspondence with the respective tax authorities.
  • Act to resolve issues which prevent effective team working, even during times of change and uncertainty.
  • Coach others and encourage them to take ownership of their development.
  • Analyze complex ideas or proposals and build a range of meaningful recommendations.
  • Address sub-standard work or work that does not meet company's/client's expectations.
  • Develop a perspective on key global trends, including globalization, and how they impact the company and our clients.
  • Manage a variety of viewpoints to build consensus and create positive outcomes for all parties.
  • Focus on building trusted relationships.
  • Uphold the company's code of ethics and business conduct.

Qualifications

  • An interest in upskilling for a digital world and technology trends, an openness to learning new tools and adapting how you work.
  • A demonstrated commitment to valuing differences, developing and coaching diverse teams, and ensuring diverse perspectives are heard.
  • Experience in expatriate tax; knowledge in Taiwan personal income tax represents an advantage.
  • 2+ years of relevant experience for senior position.
  • Candidates with less experience will be considered for the position of associates.
  • Proven ability to manage multiple assignments, clients and staff.
  • Strong analytical, organization and communication skills.
  • An ability to work effectively under pressure and a proactive attitude.
  • Fluent in Portuguese.
  • Fluent in English.
  • Education/ Graduation: Business, Law, Economy, International Relations.
  • Demonstrated business development skills and enthusiasm about contributing to the growth of the Global Mobility Services practice.

description:

Em parceria com o Complexo Hospitalar Souza Aguiar, o maior hospital de emergência da América Latina, estamos redefinindo os padrões de atendimento em saúde.

O que buscamos?

Um profissional que será responsável pelo gerenciamento ambiental de redíduos hospitalares, auxiliando na coleta, análise e organização de dados relacionados à geração, tratamento e disposição de resíduos.

  • Auxílio em inspeções: Acompanhar e auxiliar em inspeções de áreas de armazenamento e tratamento de resíduos.
  • Elaboração de relatórios: Auxiliar na elaboração de relatórios de auditoria, apresentando os resultados da análise e propondo recomendações para aprimorar o gerenciamento de resíduos.
  • Registro de dados: Registrar com precisão os dados de pesagem, incluindo peso bruto, tara e peso líquido, em planilhas ou sistemas informatizados.

  • Acompanhamento de carregamentos: Acompanhar o carregamento e descarregamento de resíduos, verificando se os pesos registrados correspondem à quantidade de resíduos transportados.
  • Organização de documentos: Manter os registros de pesagem organizados e atualizados, facilitando a consulta e a auditoria.
  • Verificação de conformidade: Verificar se os procedimentos de pesagem estão em conformidade com as normas e regulamentações ambientais.
